core_meaning.primary_meaning: Shamsuddin (شمس الدين) is a compound honorific name meaning “sun of the religion”. It is formed from shams (“sun”) and al-din (“the religion”) and was borne by numerous classical scholars, including the historian Shams al-Din al-Dhahabi (d. 748/1348). The name is not Qur'anic; it is a historical Muslim honorific.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: The compound joins two Arabic nouns in a genitive construction. Names of the form X al-Din were widespread among scholars and rulers from the medieval period. The record describes the construction and its historical bearers; it does not claim a Qur'anic origin.

urdu.name: شمس الدین
urdu.long_meaning: شمس الدین کے لغوی معنی «دین کا سورج» ہیں۔ یہ اندراج دینی حوالے اور نام کے استعمال کو الگ الگ بیان کرتا ہے؛ یہ ترجمہ ابتدائی مسودہ ہے اور مقامی جائزے کا محتاج ہے۔

persian.name: شمس‌الدین
